_comment: Seeded by 'lab/init' into <LAB_HOME>/config/lab.config.json. Identifiers only - NEVER secrets, tokens, passwords or client secrets. Those live in lab.secrets.local.json (git-ignored) or environment variables.
_identitiesComment: One entry per app registration plus how to authenticate as it. Run 'lab/setup-app-registration' to create the app and fill these in automatically.

msg-app._notes: Graph app-only. Needs application permissions consented by a tenant admin.

msg-app-cert._notes: Same app as msg-app, certificate credential. REQUIRED for SharePoint REST app-only - client secrets give 'Unsupported app only token'. Create with lab/setup-app-certificate, then upload the .cer to the app registration.

dverse-app._notes: DELEGATED user auth for Dataverse. Needs Dataverse user_impersonation and 'Allow public client flows' = Yes.

kslab-pbi._notes: DELEGATED user auth for Power BI/Fabric. Avoids service-principal export restrictions. Needs 'Allow public client flows' = Yes.

dverse-app-appauth._notes: RESERVED, dormant. Requires an Application User record in the environment plus a security role, or Dataverse returns 403 0x80072560. Use only via -Identity dverse-app-appauth.

kslab-pbi-appauth._notes: RESERVED, dormant. Requires the tenant setting 'Service principals can use Fabric APIs' plus the SP added to the workspace as Admin. Use only via -Identity kslab-pbi-appauth.

_targetsComment: One entry per test environment. Empty values produce a clean BLOCKED listing exactly what is missing - fill them in as you start using each product.

dataverse-globaldisco._notes: Global Discovery Service, not a real environment. Used by powerplatform/inspect-teams-environment to resolve an environment's Web API URL.

powerbi-fabric._notes: A workspace on Fabric capacity. Needed for Dataflow Gen2 and other Fabric-only items.

powerbi-largesem._notes: A workspace whose semantic models use large semantic model storage format (PremiumFiles).
